summary: AVGO reports FQ4 and FY2026 on Dec 9 after the close (company-confirmed). Q4 revenue is guided to ~$34.8B (+93% y/y), and EPS consensus is ~$3.82–3.83. The stock is ~33% off its high on AI-trade unwind fears, not company news. Consensus targets of ~$530 (47 Buy / 3 Hold) imply ~+60%, well past the 20% gate. Mega-cap self-check: Dec 2024 showed AVGO can add +24% in one session on an AI outlook. Caveat: the print lands on FOMC day (Dec 9), so the macro and company binaries stack. The catalyst is 28 days out, outside the 14-day North Star window, so a backtest miss there is a horizon artifact. Core Base bias is +23.7pp vs realized 14d P75 +6.6%, so Base is a ~4–8 week post-earnings re-rating horizon, not a 14-day call. Size 5–7%.

catalysts.name: FQ4 / FY2026 earnings — AI revenue + FY27 outlook
catalysts.description: Company-confirmed Dec 9, 2026 after the close (2pm PT call). Q4 guide ~$34.8B (+93% y/y); EPS consensus ~$3.82. The FY27 AI SAM/backlog commentary is the swing factor. Same day as the FOMC decision.

risks: Event stacking: earnings and FOMC on the same day (Dec 9), and Nov CPI the next morning. Even a good print can be swamped by a 50bp surprise.
Customer concentration in custom XPUs (a handful of hyperscalers). Any capex pause is magnified.
Political: data-center regulation fears hit the whole AI-infrastructure complex.
Mega-cap math: +20% means adding ~$300B of value, so it needs a genuinely narrative-changing outlook.

estimateDates.note: Q4 guide ~$34.8B; same day as FOMC

macroRisk.rateOutlook: The Fed held at 3.75–4.00% on Oct 28. After the hot Oct CPI on Nov 10, CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~89–100%, with ~10% odds of 50bp. The 10-year is ~4.98%.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct CPI: headline +0.4% m/m, core +0.3% m/m vs 0.2% expected. Sep core PCE was 3.1% y/y. Oct PCE on Nov 25 is the next print, then Nov CPI on Dec 10, the day after FOMC.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: AI semis are the epicenter of the Nov 5 selloff (SOX -9–12% on midterm data-center-regulation fears) and are rate-sensitive long-duration equities; a 50bp December surprise would extend the de-rating.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM-HIGH for timing — the print lands on FOMC day with CPI the next morning. Build the position before Dec 9 on dips, but do not add the day of the event.
